sections.text_helper: Section 11.12.13 "ADC injected data register x (ADC_JDRx) (x= 1..4)" in chapter 11 (Analog-to-digital converter (ADC)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 251.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x3C - 0x48
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reserved
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 JDATA[15:0]: Injected data
These bits are read only. They contain the conversion result from injected channel x. The
data is left or right-aligned as shown in Figure27 and Figure28.
